dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Nilou! Wanna go grab dessert after rehearsal? Puspa Café just released a limited-time special for the Sabzeruz Festival!

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Oh, um... I—I'd better not. It's almost Parade day, so I should restrain myself.

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Shame... I heard they're doing a buy one get one free promotion for their Padisarah Pudding!

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: Oh, and their tahchin is buy one get one half off...

dialogues.speaker: Najia
dialogues.text: And there was something special about the syrup for the Baklava, too...

dialogues.speaker: Nilou
dialogues.text: Ahh...! N—No more! Please! How about I just come with you...
